rules.sentence: To prevent needless and sometimes hazardous therapies, it is crucial to differentiate between HT and acquired thrombocytopenia, particularly ITP, for the category of disorders.
An effective diagnosis of HT cannot ignore the meticulous collection of personal and family history, careful physical examination, and analysis of peripheral blood smears.
Molecular analysis is necessary to confirm the diagnosis and offer patients individualized treatment, counseling, and follow-up.
At the very least, a definite diagnosis must always be sought for persons in whom a predisposing form is suspected.
